There are a few, special cases that speedily deletes articles or files “on sight”. This page lists articles using the template. Before speedily deleting an article, ensure that it meets the criteria for speedy deletion. For any discussion of pages listed for speedy deletion, please use the talk page of the article in question.

Deleted articles are automatically listed in the deletion log.

See also :Category:Pages proposed for deletion.
